source.reference_type: Re=100 CFD simulation dataset; not a physical experiment

case_inventory.mapping_gate: Before any fit, derive family, amplitude-group, and realization labels from source metadata; save a human-reviewed, hash-bound inventory. Do not infer or fabricate identifiers from presumed MAT ordering.

split_lock.assignment_basis: semantic source metadata, never guessed raw indices

final_holdout_unlock_requires: frozen ROM equations and parameter bounds
frozen objective and scoring implementation hash
prohibited_before_final_unlock: reading final-holdout cy or cx values
using final holdout for sign selection
using final holdout for pressure quadrature decisions
using final holdout for preprocessing, architecture, bounds, thresholds, fitting, or stopping decisions
access_policy.invalidation_rule: After final-holdout access, any change to signs, pressure quadrature, normalization, preprocessing, equations, bounds, coefficients, objective, or scoring creates a new benchmark version and cannot reuse the accessed holdout as final evidence.

preprocessing.time: Retain source samples; require finite, strictly increasing time and consistency with fs before any resampling.

nondimensionalization.force_coefficients: Use supplied cy and cx only after the force-sign gate; do not silently renormalize them.

stationary_frequency_anchor.peak_estimator: Peak of the single-sided Hann-windowed periodogram of mean-removed cy in the frozen 2 to 4 Hz search band, using source samples and no zero padding.
stationary_frequency_anchor.fit_boundary: Freeze omega0 before ROM fitting; omega0 is not an optimized ROM parameter.

required_metadata: positive transverse coordinate and y sign convention
cy and cx coefficient normalization and sign convention
nondimensionalization.metadata_gate: Start from the source-reported y units of m, kinematic-pressure units of m^2/s^2, and fs=40 Hz, but verify those facts against the MAT inventory. Resolve every required_metadata entry from source metadata, verify that time is in seconds and consistent with fs, and write the evidence and conversions to the inventory receipt before frequency estimation, differentiation, pressure integration, or fitting. If time units, y units, transverse coordinate sign, D, U_inf, pressure units/reference, or coefficient convention remains ambiguous, stop; no defaults may be guessed.

preprocessing.derivative: Use one frozen differentiator selected from training only; store its boundary handling and coefficients in the preprocessing receipt.
preprocessing.record_independence: Filtering, differentiation, and state initialization operate independently per record; no samples cross record boundaries.

required_inputs: source cy and cx coefficient convention

pressure_resultants.source_kinematic_pressure_p_over_rho: If and only if metadata confirms p_on_cylinder is kinematic pressure p_kin=p/rho, use C_pforce = -2 integral((p_kin-p_ref)n ds)/(U_inf^2 D), with p_ref in the same kinematic-pressure units.
pressure_resultants.dimensional_pressure: If and only if metadata confirms dimensional pressure, use C_pforce = -2 integral((p-p_ref)n ds)/(rho U_inf^2 D), with source-resolved rho and p_ref.
pressure_resultants.pressure_coefficient: If and only if metadata confirms Cp=(p-p_ref)/(0.5 rho U_inf^2), use C_pforce = -integral(Cp n ds)/D.

force_sign_and_pressure_gate.pressure_metadata_gate: The source report identifies p_on_cylinder as kinematic pressure p/rho in m^2/s^2; verify that identity against the MAT inventory, then resolve its reference p_ref together with U_inf and D. If the reported representation, units, reference, U_inf, or D is unresolved or inconsistent, stop before pressure integration, sign selection, or ROM fitting.
required_checks: establish cylinder-point ordering and close the contour
construct outward normals and verify their orientation geometrically
use source timestamps without an optimized phase shift
compare both sign candidates for transverse pressure force against supplied cy
check streamwise sign against supplied cx while treating viscous traction as a documented pressure-only closure limitation
record quadrature, normals, candidate metrics, selected sign, and input hashes
force_sign_and_pressure_gate.amplitude_policy: Do not impose exact pressure-versus-total-force amplitude closure unless source documentation establishes that cy excludes viscous traction.
force_sign_and_pressure_gate.failure_action: Stop before ROM fitting. No default time or y units, transverse sign, D, U_inf, pressure units/reference, coefficient convention, cy sign, pressure sign, contour orientation, or phase correction is permitted.

initial_state_definition.qdot0: dq/ds evaluated at s=0; the dot denotes differentiation with respect to dimensionless s, not physical time t

minimum_rom.initial_state: Fit one bounded q0=q(s=0) and qdot0=dq/ds at s=0 using training data only, then apply that identical shared state to every training, development, and final record. Record-specific phases or initial states are prohibited.
minimum_rom.common_initialization_gate: The source report states that the records use a shared developed stationary initial flow. Confirm that convention from the raw inventory before fitting. If the raw audit disproves common initialization, stop and issue a new protocol; do not repair the mismatch with record-specific force histories, phases, or states.

fit_and_score.objective: Minimize the training-only sum over records of mean((cy_hat-cy)^2) divided by that record's training cy variance; equal weight per record.
fit_and_score.development_use: One architecture and stopping decision after training; no coefficient fitting to development outputs.
fit_and_score.final_scoring: Run once after unlock with the frozen model and report all 16 records, including failures; do not refit or suppress cases.

not_established: QBlade structural-response or QBlade-coupled aeroelastic code-to-code verification
evidence_boundary.claim: This Re=100 CFD dataset can support code-to-code prescribed-motion wake-force verification independently of QBlade; it is not experimental validation and is not by itself a two-way aeroelastic validation.

license_boundary.commercial_use: Not authorized by this scaffold; obtain separate permission from the rights holders.
